DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホールでの発表会をご計画ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are planning a recital in the hall, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ピアノを使う発表会です。会場の料金とは別に、ピアノを使う手続きがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ホール料金以外のピアノ利用手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a recital using a piano. Apart from the venue fee, is there a procedure for using the piano?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the piano-use procedure in addition to the hall fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使用する設備を申込みへ記入できます。調律のご希望もございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can list the equipment you will use on the application. Would you also like tuning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。先生から調律の日を確認してほしいと言われました。自分で調律師を呼ぶ前に、手配方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 教師の調律確認依頼と調律師手配方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My teacher asked me to check the tuning date. Before calling a tuner myself, I would like to ask how arrangements are made.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your teacher's request to check tuning and ask how to arrange a tuner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 設備担当が手配の方法と費用をご説明します。発表会の開始時刻はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The equipment coordinator will explain the arrangements and costs. What time does the recital start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後二時です。調律と練習の時間もあるので、午前から借りる予定にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二時開演と午前準備練習を含む利用希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: At two in the afternoon. Since we also need time for tuning and practice, I would like to plan to rent it from the morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the two o'clock start and request use from the morning for preparation and practice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会場を使用する時間に準備も含めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please include preparation when discussing the hours you will use the venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午前十時からと書きます。鍵を受け取る時刻と、調律が終わる目安を合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十時開始記入と鍵受取り調律時刻調整を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write ten in the morning as the starting time. I would like to coordinate when I receive the key with the expected completion of tuning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will write ten as the start and coordinate key collection and tuning times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その予定で空きと設備の手配を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The coordinator will check availability and equipment arrangements based on that plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会場だけ先に確定せず、ピアノの利用と準備時間も合わせて説明を聞きます。申込みの設備欄へ記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会場設備準備を合わせた説明と設備欄記入を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Rather than confirm just the venue first, I will hear the explanation about piano use and preparation time together. I will fill in the equipment section of the application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hear the venue, equipment and preparation explanation together and complete the equipment section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、設備の相談担当へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the equipment consultation coordinator. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベッドの周りで、使いにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything around the bed that is difficult to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 呼出しボタンが棚の奥にあって、横になったままだと届きません。手元に置けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 横になって届かない呼出ボタンの位置変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The call button is at the back of the shelf, and I cannot reach it while lying down. Could you put it within reach?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to move the call button because you cannot reach it while lying down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの手で押しやすいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which hand is easier for you to press it with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左手です。右腕は点滴があるので、左側へ置いてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左手操作と右腕点滴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My left hand. I have an IV in my right arm, so I would like it placed on my left side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain using your left hand and the IV in your right arm. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 左側へ移します。コードが体の下へ入らない位置も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will move it to the left. I will also check that the cord will not go underneath your body.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この位置なら届きます。シーツの下に隠れないよう、留める場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届く位置を確認しシーツに埋もれない固定方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can reach it here. Please also show me where to clip it so it will not get hidden under the sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that it is within reach and ask how to secure it so it does not get buried in the sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの留め具で固定できます。押す前に使い方をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can secure it with this clip. I will explain how to use it before you press it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明をお願いします。押したあと、呼べたか分かる表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 操作案内と呼出完了表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please explain. After I press it, is there an indicator showing that the call went through?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for operating instructions and an indication that the call was sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの表示が変わります。確認のため一度押してみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: This indicator changes. Let us press it once to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左手で押せて、表示も変わりました。横になっても同じ場所へ届くので、必要なときに呼べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 左手試用表示と臥位で届くことを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I could press it with my left hand, and the indicator changed. I can reach the same spot even lying down, so I can call when needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report pressing it with your left hand, the indicator change and being able to reach it lying down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 使えることを確認できました。では、ゆっくりお休みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed that you can use it. Please rest comfortably now. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メッセージについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss a message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ネットで商品を売った相手から、「金を戻さないと家へ行く」と届きました。住所は発送のときに伝わっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 販売相手の返金要求と自宅訪問を脅す発言を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone I sold an item to online sent me, “If you do not return the money, I will come to your home.” They learned my address when I shipped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the buyer's refund demand and threatening statement about coming to your home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、訪ねて来ている様子はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there any sign that they are visiting right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いません。昨日の夜に届き、今朝も同じ言葉が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現訪問なしと二度の受信日時を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The message arrived last night, and the same words came again this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that no one is visiting now and give the times of the two messages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取引の経過と、相手とのやり取りを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the course of the transaction and your exchanges with the other person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 商品は届いたと連絡がありました。そのあと返金を求められ、説明している途中で脅す言葉になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品到着から返金要求への取引経過を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They told me the item had arrived. After that, they demanded a refund, and while I was explaining, their words became threatening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the transaction from delivery of the item to the refund demand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送信日時と、前後の内容が分かる画面を見せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you show a screen displaying the sending times and the messages before and after them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この画面です。怖くて消したくなりましたが、前の説明も含めて残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前後画面を保持したまま提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the screen. I was frightened and wanted to delete them, but I have kept them, including my earlier explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the screen with the surrounding messages preserved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応について担当と相談しましょう。今お一人でお住まいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us discuss how to respond with the officer in charge. Do you live alone now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人です。返金の取引問題と、訪問をほのめかされた不安を両方お伝えします。帰宅時のことも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 独居と取引問題及び訪問不安への相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will explain both the refund transaction issue and my anxiety about the implied visit. I would also like advice about returning home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you live alone and request advice on both the transaction issue and fear of a visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、経過を担当と一緒に伺います。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will hear what happened together with the officer in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send these envelopes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 結婚式の招待状です。普通の封筒より大きく、返信用の封筒も入っているので、料金を量ってほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大型招待状と返信封筒込みの料金計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are wedding invitations. They are larger than ordinary envelopes and contain reply envelopes, so I would like you to weigh them to check the postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for postage weighing for large invitations containing reply envelopes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一通を確認します。全部同じ中身でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check one. Do they all contain the same things?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十通は同じです。一通だけ地図を二枚入れたので、それは別に量ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同内容十通と地図追加一通を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ten have the same contents. Only one contains two maps, so please weigh that one separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate ten with identical contents from the one with extra maps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、同じ十通と、地図が多い一通を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I will check the ten identical ones separately from the one with more maps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 重さが同じだと思って、全部に同じ切手を貼るところでした。まだ貼っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全通同料金と考えたが未貼付と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was about to put the same stamps on all of them, thinking they weighed the same. I have not put them on yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you thought all had the same postage but have not affixed stamps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの確認結果では、地図の多い一通だけ料金が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Our check shows that only the one with more maps has different postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 違う分をそちらへ貼り、十通には案内された額を貼ります。返信用封筒の切手も用意できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加一通の異なる料金と返信用切手購入を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put the different postage on that one and the amount you told me on the ten others. Can I also get stamps for the reply envelopes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the different postage for the extra-map envelope and request reply-envelope stamps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返信用の封筒も中身と大きさに合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also check the reply envelopes according to their contents and size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返信用はこの形です。往信用十一通と返信用を別にそろえて、貼り終えたら窓口へ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往信返信の各封筒を分け計量貼付後に差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is the reply envelope. I will prepare the eleven outgoing envelopes separately from the reply envelopes and bring them to the counter after affixing the stamps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate outgoing and reply envelopes, have them weighed, affix stamps and hand them in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、それぞれの封筒を確認します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check each type of envelope. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貸金庫のご利用をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you considering using a safe-deposit box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長い証書を筒に入れています。折りたくないので、筒のまま収まる大きさがあるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 証書筒を折らず保管する貸金庫サイズを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I keep a long certificate in a tube. I do not want to fold it, so I would like to know whether there is a size that will hold the tube as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about safe-deposit-box dimensions for storing a certificate tube without folding it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 筒の長さと太さは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the tube's length and thickness?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 長さ四十五センチ、直径六センチです。写真だけ持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 筒寸法と写真だけの持参を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is forty-five centimeters long and six centimeters in diameter. I only brought a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the tube's dimensions and say that you brought only a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: サイズごとの内寸をご案内できます。内容品と利用条件は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can explain the internal dimensions of each size. The coordinator will check the contents and conditions of use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙の証書だけです。費用の前に、出し入れする口の大きさも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙証書内容と出入口寸法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It contains only a paper certificate. Before discussing fees, I would also like to ask the size of the opening for putting it in and taking it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it contains a paper certificate and ask the opening's dimensions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内部に収まるだけでなく、入口を通るかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check not only whether it fits inside but also whether it passes through the opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 斜めに入れて傷める形は避けたいです。合うサイズが空いていれば、利用の説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 傷めず収納できるサイズの空き説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to avoid damaging it by inserting it diagonally. If a suitable size is available, I would like to hear how to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about availability and use of a suitable size that allows storage without damage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 空き状況と申込みの条件をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain availability and the application requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は寸法と条件を聞きます。合う金庫があれば、実物の筒を測り直してから申し込みを考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法条件確認後に実物採寸して申込み検討を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will ask about the dimensions and requirements. If there is a suitable box, I will measure the actual tube again before considering an application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check dimensions and conditions, remeasure the actual tube and then consider applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、写真と寸法を担当へお見せください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please show the photo and dimensions to the coordinator. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱入りの飲料をお買い求めですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to buy boxed drinks, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二箱を買います。車まで一度で持てないので、運ぶ手伝いをお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飲料二箱購入と車までの運搬支援を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will buy these two cases. I cannot carry them to the car in one trip, so could someone help me transport them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are buying two cases of drinks and ask for help carrying them to the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会計後に台車でお運びできます。駐車場のどの辺りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can take them on a trolley after payment. Where in the parking lot is your car?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口に近い三番の区画です。車の後ろに積みたいので、トランクを先に開けてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三番区画とトランクを開ける準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: In space three near the entrance. I want them loaded in the back of the car, so I will open the trunk first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give parking space three and say you will open the trunk in preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お支払いの後、レシートを持って荷物の担当へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: After paying, please bring the receipt and speak to the staff member handling the goods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 支払いました。レシートは二箱になっています。トランクも開けましたので、こちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計二箱と開蓋完了を報告し支援を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have paid. The receipt shows two cases. I have also opened the trunk, so please come this way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report payment for two cases and opening the trunk, and request help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が二箱を台車へ載せます。車の中の置き場所をご指定ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will put the two cases on the trolley. Please indicate where to put them in the car.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: トランクの手前へ一箱ずつ平らに置いてください。奥には別の荷物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既存荷物を避けトランク手前の平置きを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please place the cases flat, one at a time, near the front edge of the trunk. There is other luggage farther inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify flat placement near the trunk opening, avoiding existing luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご指定の場所へ載せました。荷物がそろっているかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: They have been loaded where you requested. Please check that all your goods are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二箱そろいました。奥の荷物にも当たっていません。台車はお店へ戻していただけるので、このまま出発します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二箱と既存荷物の状態を確認し積込完了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both cases are here. They are not touching the luggage farther inside. Since you will return the trolley to the store, I will leave now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the two cases and existing luggage and report that loading is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の音声案内をお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be using the park's audio guide?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りる機器で、自分のイヤホンを使いたいです。この差込み口で合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手持ちイヤホン端子と貸出機器の適合を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to use my own earphones with the rental device. Will they fit this socket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your earphone connector is compatible with the rental device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの機器は、この形の差込み口です。お持ちの端子を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This device has a socket of this shape. Please show me your connector.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 細い丸形ではなく、スマートフォン用の端子です。直接は入らないようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スマホ用端子の不適合を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a smartphone connector rather than a thin round one. It seems it will not fit directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the smartphone connector does not fit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 貸出し用のイヤホンをご利用いただく方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use the earphones we lend out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は貸出し用を使います。左右が分かる印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 貸出イヤホンを選び左右印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use the rental earphones today. Are there markings showing left and right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the rental earphones and ask about left/right markings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さく左右の文字があります。音量を下げた状態でお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are small letters for left and right. Please try them with the volume turned down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 文字が読めました。着けてから少しずつ上げると、説明が聞こえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 左右と音量調節後の聞取りを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read the letters. After putting them on and raising the volume gradually, I can hear the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report identifying left and right and hearing the guide after adjusting the volume. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返す際は、機器とイヤホンを一緒に受付へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When returning them, please bring the device and earphones together to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つ一緒に返します。自分の端子を無理に入れず、貸出し用で聞けたので、この案内で園内を回ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二品返却と貸出音声案内による回遊を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return both together. Instead of forcing in my own connector, I could hear with the rental earphones, so I will use this guide around the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return both items and tour the park using the rental audio guide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ園内の案内をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the guide around the park. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 寝台をご希望ですね。上段と下段があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like a sleeper berth, correct? There are upper and lower berths.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上段は安い方の候補ですね。ただ、高い所へ上がる動作が苦手なので、予約前に昇り方を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上段価格候補と昇り動作の困難を説明し方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The upper berth is the less expensive option, correct? However, I have difficulty climbing up high, so I would like to know how to get up before booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention the upper berth as a cheaper option, explain difficulty climbing and ask how to get up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車内の図で、足を掛ける位置と寝台の高さをご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The carriage diagram shows the footholds and berth height.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 図ではかなり高く見えます。はしごで上がる形なら、荷物を持ったまま昇るのは難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図で高さを見て荷物保持での昇降懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It looks quite high in the diagram. If you climb a ladder, doing so while carrying luggage seems difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Comment on the height in the diagram and concern about climbing with luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の収納位置も図にあります。上下の空きは、予約担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The luggage-storage location is also shown. The reservations staff will check availability of both upper and lower berths.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回は下段を希望します。上段の料金だけで決めるより、使いやすさを優先したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 料金より使いやすさから下段を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like a lower berth this time. I would rather prioritize ease of use than decide only by the upper berth's price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a lower berth for ease of use rather than price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 下段のご希望で空きを見ます。出発日はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check for a lower berth. Is this the correct departure date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来月の十日です。下段が空いていなければ、十一日も候補にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十日希望と十一日代案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The tenth of next month. If no lower berth is available, the eleventh is also possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the tenth as your preferred date and the eleventh as an alternative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 十日の下段は満席ですが、十一日に空きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The lower berths are full on the tenth, but there is availability on the eleventh.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十一日の下段にします。日程を一日ずらしても、昇らずに入れる寝台を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十一日下段の空きを選び日程変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the lower berth on the eleventh. Even if it means moving the trip by one day, I will choose a berth I can enter without climbing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the available lower berth on the eleventh and change your schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、十一日の下段でお手続きをご案内します。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will explain the booking process for a lower berth on the eleventh. Have a pleasant trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水の検査についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss water testing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の井戸水を検査したいです。家にある空き瓶へ入れて持って来ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家庭井戸水検査の容器を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to have my home's well water tested. Can I bring it in an empty bottle I have at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the container for testing your household well water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付する検査と採水の方法は、環境の担当がご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The environmental coordinator will explain which tests are accepted and how to collect the sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ水は持って来ていません。容器を使う前に、専用の物が必要か知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未採水と専用容器要否を事前確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not brought any water yet. Before using a container, I would like to know whether a special one is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not collected the water and check in advance whether a special container is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容器の用意と提出する日を合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check both how to prepare the container and the submission day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 平日は水曜なら来られます。容器を受け取る日と、水を出す日は別でもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水曜来庁可能と容器受取及び提出別日可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: On weekdays I can come on Wednesday. Can I collect the container and submit the water on different days?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can visit on Wednesday and ask whether container collection and sample submission may be on different days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取方法と提出日を担当へ確認します。調べたい理由も伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the coordinator about collection and submission. May I also ask why you want the test?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 以前と比べてにおいが変わったためです。検査の項目も、その事情を伝えて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: におい変化を理由として検査項目を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Because the smell has changed compared with before. I would like to explain that and discuss which items to test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss test items because the smell has changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: においの変化と、水曜のご希望を申し送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on the change in smell and your preference for Wednesday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。検査の項目、容器、採る時刻、提出する日を聞いてから準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 項目容器採水時刻提出日の案内後に準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will prepare after asking about the test items, container, collection time and submission day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare after receiving guidance on test items, container, sampling time and submission day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、環境の相談担当へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the environmental consultation coordinator. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院後の訪問について、ご確認はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have anything to check about the visits after discharge?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 訪問看護をお願いしています。初日は家で一人ですが、歩くのに時間がかかるので、玄関を開ける方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初回訪問看護時の独居と歩行時間による玄関応答を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have arranged home nursing. I will be alone at home on the first day, and walking takes me time, so I would like to discuss how to answer the front door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss answering the door for the first home-nursing visit because you are alone and walking takes time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、玄関の呼び鈴はお部屋から聞こえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you hear the front-door bell from your room now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 聞こえます。ただ、ベッドから立って玄関へ行く間に、帰ってしまわないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 呼鈴可聴と移動中に帰られる不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. But I worry they may leave while I get out of bed and walk to the door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain hearing the bell and concern that the visitor may leave while you move to the door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訪問の担当へ、応答まで時間が必要と申し送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the visiting staff member that you need time to answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。先に電話をしてもらえれば、手元の電話で返事をしてから玄関へ向かえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 事前電話で返答し玄関に向かう方法を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If they call beforehand, I can answer the phone beside me and then head to the door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a phone call first so you can answer and then go to the door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 事前の電話と初回の時刻は、訪問する担当と調整しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us coordinate the advance call and first visit time with the visiting staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時刻が分かれば準備できます。鍵を外へ置く方法ではなく、自分が開ける形にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訪問時刻確認と本人が解錠する方法を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I know the time, I can prepare. I would like to open the door myself instead of leaving a key outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the visit time and request a method in which you unlock the door yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えます。自宅の入口の写真はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on that preference too. Do you have a photo of your home's entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この写真です。門と玄関が別なので、どちらの呼び鈴かも担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 門と玄関が別の写真で呼鈴位置の引継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is a photo. The gate and front door are separate, so please also tell the staff member which bell to ring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the photo showing separate gate and front door to request passing on the bell location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真とご希望を引き継ぎます。それでは、訪問の担当と調整します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on the photo and your preferences. We will coordinate with the visiting staff member. Goodbye.
